intent: Choose exactly one option from a small visible set. Custom circle, not a native radio. One piece.
useWhen: Two to six mutually exclusive options that should stay visible
Settings where users compare options side by side
doNotUseWhen: Tabs for panel switching — use Tabs

describedBy.note: Extra id(s) for aria-describedby on the group, after the hint or error.

error.note: Group error message. Tints the radios.

hideLegend.note: Keeps the legend for assistive tech, hides it visually. Use when Drawer already shows the title.

layout.note: card is bordered rows with the radio on the right. Compose Badge via option.badge.

requirements: The fieldset has role=radiogroup and is named by its legend (aria-labelledby)
Each radio is a native input type=radio with a visible label
error sets aria-invalid on the radiogroup, not on each radio; the error or hint is the group's aria-describedby
Disabled options stay in the a11y tree but cannot be selected

doNot: Do not invent Radio, RadioGroupItem, or RadioGroupLegend cousins
Do not use a native unstyled radio with accent-color
Do not use for tabbed content — use Tabs
Do not use for multi-select — use Checkbox
snippet:
<RadioGroup name="plan" legend="Plan" size="lg" defaultValue="pro" options={[
  { value: 'starter', label: 'Starter' },
  { value: 'pro', label: 'Studio Pro' },
]} />
